rejudged.primitives_used: spiral or spiral_speed for the initial spiral; form_circle, form_star, form_cone, zig_zag, and single-drone move can create abrupt reorganisations or limited opposing motion, but not coordinated two-stream separation followed by a controlled recoil. light_color with red/orange, combined with strobe_decay or blink using white accents, can provide saturated storm colours and hard flashes.

rejudged.motion: The drones regroup into a tall, narrow column rising through the center of the volume. The column bends and sways as one body, then briefly buckles near its middle, like a flame being battered by wind.
rejudged.lighting: Begin with a concentrated white-hot core at the center, fading through gold and orange toward the edges. Let the lower portion glow red, giving the column a furnace-like intensity.
rejudged.missing: No primitive can make a narrow column bend and sway as one coherent body and then buckle specifically near its middle. The motion primitives provide global twists, waves, or zigzags rather than localized column deformation. A single gradient also cannot precisely provide a multi-stop white-hot-to-gold-to-orange transition, though it can approximate it.
rejudged.primitives_used: form_cone or stacked form_circle formations for the tall central grouping; helix, twister, or zig_zag for collective motion; gradient by radius for a white-to-orange/amber falloff; light_color on the lower height-selected drones for red; pulse or strobe_decay for furnace-like intensity

rejudged.motion: The column explodes outward into a wide radial burst, then the drones race along curved paths that form a rapidly rotating crown. The crown should feel grand, unstable, and close to breaking apart.
rejudged.lighting: Use brilliant gold and searing white on the outward burst, followed by fast-moving red and orange bands around the crown. Add brief blue-violet shadows between bursts so the brightness feels violent rather than uniformly bright.
rejudged.missing: No essential capability is missing. Gold can be represented with amber/yellow, and blue-violet with blue/indigo from the available palette.
rejudged.primitives_used: form_circle for the outward radial burst; spiral_speed and/or twister for curved, rapidly rotating crown paths with increasing radius and unstable separation; light_color or gradient using amber/yellow with white for the gold-white burst; gradient or partitioned light_color using red and orange combined with neighbour-based chase for moving crown bands; blue/indigo light_color or gradient with blink, pulse, strobe_decay, or alternate_blink for brief shadow-like accents between bursts.

rejudged.motion: The crown collapses inward and the swarm plunges into a low, jagged wave spanning the width of the space. The wave travels from one side to the other with sharp rises and drops, like a storm front striking in successive blows.
rejudged.lighting: Alternate icy blue-white flashes with dark red pulses as the wave travels. Each crest should flare brightly for an instant, while the troughs fall almost black, creating a stark visual rhythm.
rejudged.missing: There is no true traveling wave primitive: wave creates a 2D standing-wave surface, and zig_zag does not make a coordinated wave front that propagates from one side to the other. Lighting can be timed and swept approximately, but cannot be intrinsically coupled to actual wave crests and troughs.
rejudged.primitives_used: center and move_z can collapse the crown inward and plunge the swarm lower; zig_zag can create sharp, jagged rises and drops, while sweep, chase, alternate_blink, blink, strobe_decay, light_color, and light_off can produce alternating blue-white flashes, red pulses, bright crests, and dark troughs.

rejudged.motion: The drones shoot upward and outward into a fractured constellation, then freeze in an asymmetric suspended pattern with large empty gaps. A few drones make tiny, delayed adjustments, as if the storm has exhausted itself but has not truly disappeared.
rejudged.lighting: End with cold white points edged in pale blue, while one or two isolated drones retain a dim red glow. Fade the constellation slowly into darkness, leaving a final ominous ember rather than a warm resolution.
rejudged.missing: No primitive creates an arbitrary fractured, asymmetric constellation with deliberately large empty gaps as a multi-drone formation. Single-drone moves cannot define the overall shape. There is also no true dim static glow or smooth slow fade to darkness; brightness effects pulse, blink, decay after flashes, or switch off, so the final isolated red ember cannot be represented exactly.
rejudged.primitives_used: form_star, form_cone, spiral, helix, zig_zag, move for isolated single-drone accents; gradient or light_color for white/blue hues; light_color for red accents; pulse, blink, strobe_decay, and light_off for brightness changes

rejudged.song: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
rejudged.motion: Begin as ten gentle points of light spread loosely across the space at different heights, drifting inward and upward as if snowflakes are being carried by a soft breeze. The swarm should feel exploratory and magical rather than static.
rejudged.lighting: Use dim, cool white and pale blue lights with subtle shimmering variation. A few points should glint briefly like ice crystals while the overall image remains delicate and spacious.
rejudged.missing: The lighting can approximate cool white/pale blue shimmer with brief glints, but the motion primitives do not express ten loosely dispersed points at different heights drifting individually inward and upward like snowflakes. They mainly create organised formations or group motions; per-drone moves cannot be credited as a multi-drone drifting pattern.
rejudged.primitives_used: form_circle, form_cone, helix, spiral, move_z, move, light_color, gradient, pulse, strobe_decay, blink

rejudged.song: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
rejudged.motion: Gather into a large, slow-turning Christmas bell made from the ten drones. Let the bell swing slightly from side to side, with a graceful arc that gives it a sense of ringing without becoming frantic.
rejudged.lighting: Shift to warm gold and amber, with a brighter golden outline and a softer white glow inside the bell. Pulse the brightness gently on the implied ringing motion.
rejudged.missing: No primitive creates a recognizable Christmas-bell silhouette with an outline, interior, or clapper. The available motion primitives also cannot produce a smooth side-to-side swinging arc; rotate only turns the formation, while zig_zag is not a graceful swing.
rejudged.primitives_used: form_cone or form_circle for an approximate clustered silhouette; rotate for slow turning; light_color with amber/orange/yellow and white, plus pulse for gentle brightness breathing

rejudged.song: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
rejudged.motion: Break the bell apart into a sweeping spiral, then send the drones outward into a circular ornament-like formation. The circle should rotate smoothly, as though a glass bauble is turning in the air.
rejudged.lighting: Use rich red, emerald green, and warm white distributed around the circle. Make the colors travel slowly around the rotating ornament, with occasional pinpoint sparkles like reflected lights.
rejudged.missing: The palette has green and white, but not specifically emerald or warm white. rainbow also travels through the full spectrum rather than limiting the moving colors to red, emerald green, and warm white, so the exact requested color treatment is not fully expressible.
rejudged.primitives_used: spiral or spiral_speed for the bell breaking into a sweeping spiral; form_circle for the outward circular ornament formation; rotate for smooth rotation; rainbow with neighbour spread for colors travelling around the formation; light_color, gradient, pulse, chase, or strobe_decay for static color assignments and pinpoint-like sparkles.

rejudged.song: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
rejudged.motion: Reassemble into a clearly recognizable five-pointed star, broad and balanced in the center of the volume. Hold the star proudly, then give it a slow, elegant tilt and return it to face the audience.
rejudged.lighting: Make the star brilliant warm white with a soft golden halo. Brighten the points one after another, followed by a full-star shimmer that feels like a magical reveal.
rejudged.missing: The primitives cannot reliably target the star's five points as distinct groups, so chase runs across drones rather than brightening the five points one after another. They also cannot create a true halo outside the star; gradient only changes the colors of the drones themselves.
rejudged.primitives_used: form_star for the recognizable five-pointed star; rotate on a horizontal axis followed by a reverse rotate for the tilt and return; light_color and gradient using white with amber or yellow by radius for a warm-white/golden treatment; chase for sequential brightening; pulse or strobe_decay for the full-star shimmer.

rejudged.song: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
rejudged.motion: Transform the star into the upper half of a Christmas tree, with the drones cascading downward into layered branches. Add a gentle vertical sway, as if the tree is alive in a quiet winter breeze.
rejudged.lighting: Use deep green as the main color, with warm white and red points appearing as ornaments. The top drone should glow gold, creating a clear tree topper while the lower branches twinkle in alternating colors.
rejudged.missing: The primitives do not create distinct layered branch tiers or a precise upper-half Christmas-tree structure; form_cone is only a continuous cone. There is no exact gold color, and no selector reliably targeting the single top drone for the topper. The closest result would therefore lose noticeable branch layering and topper-color/target precision.
rejudged.primitives_used: form_cone and form_star can create a tree-like conical transformation; repeated move_z actions can provide vertical sway. light_color with green, white, red, amber or yellow, combined with upper/lower, parity or side selectors and alternate_blink, pulse, or chase, can create colored ornaments and twinkling effects.

rejudged.song: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
rejudged.motion: Let the tree dissolve into falling snow: the drones travel in staggered downward paths, then sweep back upward in a soft looping pattern. Finish by gathering into a loose, joyful arc that suggests snowfall settling around the scene.
rejudged.lighting: Return to icy white, pale blue, and silver. Keep the lights sparkling asynchronously, with brief bright flakes and a gradual warm glow beginning to emerge near the center.
rejudged.missing: There is no primitive for forming a loose arc; form_circle creates a full circle rather than an arc. The palette also has no silver or pale-white colour, only approximations such as white, azure, cyan, or blue.
rejudged.primitives_used: zig_zag for staggered downward paths, helix for the upward looping sweep, form_circle or another formation primitive for gathering, plus gradient, light_color, chase, strobe_decay, pulse, and ripple_light for icy hues, sparkling motion, and a central warmening effect

rejudged.song: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
rejudged.motion: Use the arc as the rim of a large wreath, closing the formation into a full circle with a clear opening in the middle. Rotate the wreath slowly while the drones bob with a buoyant, celebratory rhythm.
rejudged.lighting: Light the wreath in evergreen green with evenly spaced red and gold accents. Add a warm white inner glow so the center remains inviting and unmistakable.
rejudged.missing: The primitives cannot reliably create evenly spaced red and gold accents on an otherwise green circular wreath, since available spatial selectors and colour patterns do not support that exact arrangement. Bobbing is also only approximate rather than a dedicated buoyant rhythmic motion.
rejudged.primitives_used: form_circle for the wreath rim, rotate for slow rotation, move_z or a multi-step vertical motion for approximate bobbing, light_color and brightness primitives for green/red/amber-white lighting, with a second inner circle possible for an inner glow

rejudged.song: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
rejudged.motion: Open the wreath and send the drones into a sweeping figure-eight around one another, like ribbons of festive light dancing through the air. The crossing should be smooth and symmetrical, with the swarm briefly forming two interlocking loops.
rejudged.lighting: Use alternating candy-cane red and warm white trails of light, enriched with small gold flashes at each crossing. Increase brightness through the center of the figure-eight for a feeling of joyful lift.
rejudged.missing: No primitive defines a smooth, coordinated figure-eight path with two interlocking loops and controlled crossings. The lighting can approximate red/white alternation and flashes using white plus amber or yellow, but there is no exact warm-white/gold palette, no persistent light-trail primitive, and no way to synchronize gold flashes specifically to the figure-eight crossings or make brightness rise specifically through its center.
rejudged.primitives_used: Motion primitives such as form_circle, rotate, spiral, helix, twister, and zig_zag can create circular, twisting, and sweeping group motion. Lighting can use light_color, gradient, pulse, chase, strobe_decay, ripple_light, and alternating selections such as even/odd or left/right.

rejudged.song: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
rejudged.motion: Collapse the figure-eight into ten rising candles or glowing points arranged in a gentle ascending fan. Have the fan breathe outward and inward, then lift together as though making a shared wish.
rejudged.lighting: Give each drone a warm candle-gold core with a soft amber halo. Flicker subtly and independently at first, then synchronize into one bright, steady golden swell.
rejudged.missing: No primitive creates a true ten-point ascending fan from the figure-eight or a clearly radial outward/inward breathing motion. The two LED rings can suggest core and halo but not a soft concentric halo, and brightness effects are group-based rather than independently flickering per drone at first. The exact candle-gold hue is also unavailable.
rejudged.primitives_used: form_cone for an ascending fan-like formation, repeated form_cone or form_circle changes for an approximate outward/inward breath, move_z(all, ...) for the shared lift, light_color with yellow/orange or amber on one LED deck and amber on the other for a warm two-tone core/halo approximation, pulse or blink for synchronized swelling

rejudged.song: We Wish You a Merry Christmas
rejudged.motion: From the rising fan, form a large radiant star high in the available space, with the remaining shape reading as a small wreath or cradle beneath it. Hold the complete Christmas tableau for the ending, adding one slow upward float and a final calm settling motion.
rejudged.lighting: Use brilliant warm white and gold for the star, surrounded by a restrained halo of red and green from the lower wreath. Finish with all ten lights glowing together, then soften slightly while preserving the star as the last clear image.
rejudged.missing: form_star has no drone subset selector, so it cannot leave a separate group of drones arranged as a lower wreath or cradle while the rest form the star. The star, hold, upward float, settling motion, and coordinated softening are expressible. Gold/warm white can only be approximated with the available amber, yellow, and white palette.
rejudged.primitives_used: form_star, form_circle, form_cone, move_z, light_color, gradient, light_on, pulse
